# coordinate observation of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:coordinateObservationOf`](gmeow-coordinateObservationOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coordinateObservationOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The place whose coordinates or geometry are being observed — the [`observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) of a coordinate observation. Subproperty of [`gmeow:spatialMeasurementOf`](gmeow-spatialMeasurementOf.md) (itself a subproperty of [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md)) so generic consumers can query all observations without knowing the domain.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CoordinateObservation`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateObservation.md) -> [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:spatialMeasurementOf`](gmeow-spatialMeasurementOf.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:coordinateObservationOf`](gmeow-coordinateObservationOf.md) from [`gmeow:CoordinateObservation`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateObservation.md) to [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:spatialMeasurementOf`](gmeow-spatialMeasurementOf.md), [`gmeow:CoordinateObservation`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateObservation.md), [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the place a coordinate observation observed; a subproperty of [`gmeow:spatialMeasurementOf`](gmeow-spatialMeasurementOf.md) (and thence [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it for non-place features (use the broader [`gmeow:spatialMeasurementOf`](gmeow-spatialMeasurementOf.md)).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:coordinateObservationOf`](gmeow-coordinateObservationOf.md) on the [`CoordinateObservation`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateObservation.md); generic observation queries reach it via the spine.

### Examples

- ex:obs2023 [`gmeow:coordinateObservationOf`](gmeow-coordinateObservationOf.md) ex:edinburgh.
